newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo General Insurance to float 51 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Lippo General Insurance to float 51 mln shares.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Lippo General Insurance, a unit of the Lippo group, said on Monday it will float 51 million of its shares, or a 34 percent stake, next month.
The company's president director M.F Tumbelaka said 80 percent of the total proceeds would be used to strengthen the company's assets through prudent and profitable investment.
"The remaining 20 percent would be allocated to increase the firm's reserves, develop management information systems and network expansion," Tumbelaka told a gathering of prospective clients.
He said currently fire insurance contributed 46 percent to the company's total income, followed by vehicle insurance with a 23 percent contribution.
Tumbelaka said health insurance and marine cargo contributed 14 percent and six percent respectively to total income, while the remaining 11 percent came from other insurance products.
The company said the offer price of the shares would be based on 1997 earnings per share at 190 rupiah and the 1997 price earnings ratio at 11.7 times.
Tumbelaka has been previously quoted as saying 1997 earnings were estimated at 19.1 billion rupiah.
Lippo Securities and BNP Prime East were appointed as joint lead underwriters.
The company said the offering period was tentatively scheduled for June 30 to July 2 with the listing date on July 24.
The company said it posted a net income of 5.8 billion rupiah for 1996, double the 2.6 billion rupiah in the previous year.
It also said it booked net premiums of 12.9 billion rupiah in 1996, up from 11.0 billion rupiah in 1995.
